item.title: [View Briefing] 'Jeong Cheong-rae also joins' President Lee's homecoming event ([뷰리핑] 이 대통령 귀국 행사에 ‘정청래도 함께’)
item.description:
Host: Ha Eo-young, political team reporter for The Hankyoreh. Guests: Attorney Shin In-gyu, Current affairs commentator Park Young-sik (진행: 하어영 한겨레 정치팀 기자. 출연: 신인규 변호사, 박영식 시사평론가)

Both Jeong Cheong-rae and Kim Min-seok attended President Lee's homecoming event. Jeong Cheong-rae: "The Democratic Party is all pro-Lee... Pro-Cheong and Pro-Seok are divisive tactics." Is the Democratic Party's competition over political lines intensifying? At the People Power Party general meeting, 'resign' and 'non-communication' were hurled at Jang Dong-hyuk. Han Dong-hoon begins moves for reinstatement... Former key pro-Yoon faction members join. Special prosecution seeks 1 year and 6 months in prison for Oh Se-hoon over 'poll expense reimbursement allegations.' Ministry of the Interior received report on 'voting suspension' only the next day, with no log. Police investigate suspicions of 'self-staged terrorism' by Reform Party's Busan mayoral candidate. For today's (June 18) View Briefing, your viewership is highly appreciated. (이 대통령 귀국 행사에 정청래·김민석 모두 참석/정청래 “민주당은 모두 친명… 친청·친석은 갈라치기”/민주, 노선 경쟁 본격화?/장동혁 면전서 “사퇴” “불통” 쏟아진 국힘 의총/한동훈, 복당 시동거나…‘옛 친윤계 주축’ 가입/특검, ‘여론조사비 대납 의혹’ 오세훈 징역 1년 6개월 구형/행안부 ‘투표 중단’ 이튿날에야 보고받고 일지도 없었다/경찰, 개혁신당 부산시장 후보 ‘테러 자작극’ 의혹 수사. 오늘 (06월 18일) 뷰리핑 많은 시청바랍니다.)

item.title: Lee Jun-seok on Jeong Yi-han's alleged 'self-staged attack and concussion': "Apology... cooperating with investigation" (이준석, 정이한 ‘피습 뇌진탕 자작극’ 의혹에 “사과…수사 협조”)
item.description:
Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, said on the 17th regarding suspicions of a 'self-staged attack' by Jeong Yi-han, a former candidate who ran in the June 3 Busan mayoral election, "We will operate a party fact-finding team and strictly hold former candidate Jeong to the highest level of civil and criminal responsibility based on the facts that emerge." (이준석 개혁신당 대표가 6·3부산시장 선거에 출마했던 정이한 후보의 ‘피습 자작극’ 의혹에 대해 “당 자체 진상조사단을 가동해 드러나는 사실관계에 따라 정 전 후보에게 최고 강도의 민·형사상 책임을 엄정히 묻겠다”고 17일 말했다.)

On Facebook that day, Representative Lee wrote, "Since he was a candidate nominated by the Reform Party, we feel an infinite sense of responsibility for this matter," adding, "I once again bow my head in apology to the citizens of Busan who have been hurt by this incident, and to all those who supported the Reform Party in good faith." (이 대표는 이날 페이스북에 “개혁신당이 공천한 후보였기에, 저희는 이 사안에 대해 무한한 책임감을 느낀다”며 “이 사건으로 마음에 상처를 입으신 부산 시민 여러분, 그리고 선의로 개혁신당을 지지해주신 모든 분들께 다시 한번 머리 숙여 사과드린다”고 썼다.)

Representative Lee stated, "If the information disclosed by investigative authorities and reported by the media is true, this is a grave election crime that is difficult even to imagine," and "The Reform Party will actively cooperate with all procedures of the investigative authorities to ensure not a single shred of doubt remains." (이 대표는 “수사기관이 공개하고 언론이 보도한 내용이 사실이라면, 이는 상상하기조차 어려운 중대한 선거범죄”라며 “개혁신당은 한 치의 의혹도 남지 않도록 수사기관의 모든 절차에 적극적으로 협조하겠다”고 했다.)

Previously, former candidate Jeong publicly revealed on April 27 that while campaigning near Gu-seo Interchange in Geumjeong-gu, Busan, he was hit by a drink thrown out of a car window by a man from a passing vehicle. At the time, his campaign announced that Jeong fainted while trying to dodge the drink, was taken to the hospital, and was diagnosed with a concussion and bruises. Police are investigating the possibility that the incident was a self-staged act, and former candidate Jeong withdrew from the party using the party's online system. (앞서, 정 전 후보는 지난 4월27일 부산 금정구 구서나들목 인근에서 선거운동을 하던 중 지나가던 승용차에서 남성이 차창 밖으로 던진 음료에 맞았다고 언론에 공개했다. 당시 캠프는 정 전 후보가 음료를 피하려다 넘어져 의식을 잃고 병원으로 옮겨졌으며 뇌진탕과 근좌상 진단을 받았다고 밝혔다. 경찰은 이 사건과 관련해 자작극 가능성을 수사 중이고, 정 전 후보는 당 온라인시스템을 이용해 탈당했다.)

Reporter Kim Hae-jeong sea@hani.co.kr (김해정 기자 sea@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Gyeonggi lawmakers of the People Power Party cancel press conference demanding 'Chang Dong-hyuk's resignation' one hour prior (‘장동혁 사퇴 촉구’ 회견 1시간 전에 취소한 국힘 경기 의원들)
item.description:
Lawmakers from Gyeonggi Province belonging to the People Power Party (PPP) announced and then canceled a press conference on the 18th demanding the resignation of party leader Chang Dong-hyuk. (국민의힘 소속 경기 지역 의원들이 18일 장동혁 대표 사퇴를 촉구하는 기자회견을 예고했다가 취소했다. )

PPP lawmakers with constituencies in Gyeonggi Province were scheduled to hold a press conference at 1:30 p.m. that day at the National Assembly Communication Center to call for Chang's resignation, but around noon they stated the press conference would be canceled. (경기도에 지역구를 둔 국민의힘 의원들은 이날 오후 1시30분 국회 소통관에서 기자회견을 열고 장 대표 사퇴를 촉구할 예정이었으나, 이날 낮 12시께 회견을 취소한다고 밝혔다. )

They had planned to issue a statement that the public sentiment in the Seoul metropolitan area, as confirmed by the results of the June 3 local elections, requires a change in the party leadership's course, and that Chang should step down for this purpose. Initially, it was reported that among the PPP lawmakers in Gyeonggi Province, excluding lawmaker Ahn Cheol-soo, the names of Kim Sun-kyo, Kim Sung-won, Song Seok-joon, Kim Eun-hye, Kim Yong-tae, and Yoo Eui-dong were to be included in the press release. However, as some lawmakers expressed reservations, the press conference itself appears to have fallen through. ( 이들은 6·3 지방선거 결과에서 확인된 수도권 민심은 당 지도부의 노선 변화라며, 이를 위해 장 대표가 물러나야 한다는 입장을 낼 예정이었다. 애초 기자회견문에는 경기 지역 국민의힘 의원 가운데 안철수 의원을 제외한 김선교·김성원·송석준·김은혜·김용태·유의동 의원이 이름을 올리기로 알려졌는데, 일부 의원이 보류 의사를 밝히면서 기자회견 자체가 무산된 것으로 보인다. )

The PPP will hold a general meeting of lawmakers at 1:40 p.m. that day at the National Assembly. This is a session to discuss the agenda items to be submitted to the plenary session at 2 p.m., and attention is focused on whether internal voices regarding Chang's status will erupt there as well. ( 국민의힘은 이날 오후 1시40분 국회에서 의원총회를 연다. 오후 2시 본회의에 상정하는 안건에 대해 논의하기 위한 자리인데 여기에서도 장 대표 거취에 대한 당내 목소리가 분출될 것인지에 눈길이 쏠린다.)

Earlier, at the PPP's general meeting of lawmakers the previous day, remarks calling for Chang's resignation had already emerged. Lawmaker Song Seok-joon, speaking with reporters after the general meeting, said, "The election, which should have been a judgment on the Lee Jae-myung administration, ended up being a judgment on Chang Dong-hyuk, who failed to adopt the proper party course," and added, "In the spirit of a responsible fixed term, if you lose a major election, you should step down and take responsibility, so I recommended Chang's resignation." ( 앞서 전날 국민의힘 의원총회에서도 장 대표 사퇴 촉구 발언이 나온 바 있다. 송석준 의원은 의총 뒤 기자들과 만나 “이재명 정부에 대한 심판이 돼야 할 선거가 오히려 제대로 된 당의 노선을 취하지 않은 장 대표에 대한 심판이 되고 말았다”며 “중요 선거에서 패하면 책임지고 물러나는 것이 책임형 임기제라는 의미에서 장 대표에게 사퇴를 권유했다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee returns home... Jung Cheong-rae greets him with a '90-degree bow' (이 대통령 귀국…정청래 ‘90도 인사’로 맞이)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung returned home on the 18th after concluding his first European tour, an 8-night, 10-day trip. (이재명 대통령이 8박10일간 첫 유럽 순방을 마치고 18일 귀국했다.)

The President arrived at Seoul Air Base in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, at 11:34 a.m. that day. Jung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, attended and bowed to President Lee at nearly a 90-degree angle. President Lee told Leader Jung, "You did a good job." Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, known to be running in the upcoming Democratic Party convention in August, also attended alongside. Han Byeong-do, the Democratic Party's floor leader; Kang Hoon-sik, the presidential chief of staff; and Hong Ik-pyo, the senior presidential secretary for political affairs, were also present. ( 이 대통령은 이날 오전 11시34분 경기 성남 서울공항에 도착했다. 정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 이날 참석해 이 대통령에게 90도 가까이 허리를 굽혀 인사했다. 이 대통령은 정 대표에게 “수고했다”고 말했다. 오는 8월 민주당 전당대회에 출마할 것으로 알려진 김민석 국무총리도 나란히 참석했다. 한병도 민주당 원내대표와 강훈식 대통령비서실장, 홍익표 정무수석 등도 자리했다.)

Previously, on the 9th, Leader Jung had not seen President Lee off on his departure overseas, which led to various interpretations. The Blue House explained at the time, "Considering the domestic situation, such as the prolonged Middle East war and poor management by the National Election Commission, we minimized the number of people from the Blue House and cabinet seeing him off." ( 앞서 정 대표는 지난 9일 이 대통령의 출국길에 배웅하지 않아 이를 두고 여러 해석이 나왔다. 청와대는 당시 “중동 전쟁의 장기화와 선거관리위원회 부실 관리 대응 등 국내 상황을 고려해 청와대와 내각 인사 등 환송 인원을 최소화했다”고 설명했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( 서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [Photo] President Lee Jae-myung Returns Home…Party Leader Jeong Cheong-rae's Respectful Welcome ([포토] 이재명 대통령 귀국길…정청래 대표 깍듯한 마중)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung returned home on the 18th after completing his European tour. (유럽 순방을 마친 이재명 대통령이 18일 귀국했다.)

President Lee arrived at Seoul Airport on the morning of this day, finishing a 10-day, 9-night schedule. The welcome ceremony at the airport was attended by Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae, Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, and others. During the send-off event for President Lee's tour on the 9th, only Prime Minister Kim attended, while party leader Jeong and other ruling party leaders were absent due to Yoon Administration's supposed wishes, leading to interpretations in political circles that Jeong was intentionally excluded. A collection of on-site photos is compiled here. (이 대통령은 9박10일 일정을 마치고 이날 오전 서울공항에 도착했다. 공항에서 열린 귀국 환영 행사에는 정청래 더불어민주당 대표와 김민석 국무총리 등도 참석했다. 지난 9일 이 대통령 순방 환송 행사 때는 김 총리만 참석하고 정 대표 등 여당 지도부는 청와대 뜻으로 불참해 의도적인 정 대표 배제란 해석이 정치권에서 나오기도 했다. 현장 사진을 모아본다.)

Reporter Park Jong-sik anaki@hani.co.kr (박종식 기자 anaki@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Returning Home to Brief on European Tour Results Tomorrow (귀국 이 대통령, 유럽순방 성과 내일 직접 브리핑한다)
item.description:
The presidential office said on the 18th that President Lee Jae-myung will directly brief on the outcomes of his first European tour, which lasted 10 days and 8 nights. (이재명 대통령이 8박10일간 첫 유럽 순방 결과에 대해 직접 브리핑한다고 18일 청와대가 밝혔다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung stated on the same day, "President Lee will personally brief on the results and achievements of his official visit to Belgium, the European Union (EU) summit, the state visit to Italy, and the Group of Seven (G7) summit, at the Chunchugwan press room in the presidential office at 2 PM on the 19th." (강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 이날 “이 대통령이 19일 오후 2시 벨기에 공식 방문, 유럽연합(EU) 정상회담, 이탈리아 국빈 방문 등 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 결과와 성과에 대해 청와대 춘추관에서 직접 브리핑할 예정”이라고 말했다.)

President Lee began his first European tour on the 9th and returned to Seoul Airport on the same day. (이 대통령은 지난 9일부터 첫 유럽 순방 일정을 소화하고, 이날 서울공항을 통해 귀국했다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "Trump proposed a couple's golf game… received a signing pen as a gift" (이 대통령 “트럼프, 부부 동반 골프 제안…서명용 펜 선물받아”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated on the 17th (local time) that he had secured a promise to play golf with U.S. President Donald Trump, saying, "The South Korea-U.S. relationship is solid and eternal." (이재명 대통령이 17일(현지시각) 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 골프를 함께하기로 약속받았다며 “한미관계는 단단하고 영원하다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee shared this in a post on X (formerly Twitter) after boarding the return flight following a 9-night, 10-day European tour. He said, "During dinner yesterday, we talked about golf, and he said he would golf with my wife and me, so my wife made him pinky-promise. Then today, as we parted after lunch, he again insisted we must definitely golf together. I thought it was just a passing remark, but now I think I need to prepare. I am deeply grateful to President Trump for his special interest." Along with the post, President Lee also uploaded a selfie taken with President Trump at the dinner venue. <<> President Lee sat next to President Trump at the official dinner of the Group of Seven (G7) summit on the 16th and conversed for about an hour and a half. Following Trump's golf proposal at that dinner, the same offer was made again the next day during the official luncheon. President Lee said, "During dinner last night with President Trump, we had an in-depth conversation about peace on the Korean Peninsula and South Korea-U.S. relations for about 90 minutes, and we made significant progress." <<> President Lee also shared that he received a signing pen as a gift from President Trump. During the South Korea-U.S. summit held in Washington, D.C., in August last year, President Trump had shown interest in a signing pen President Lee was using while writing in the guestbook at the White House, leading Lee to gift it on the spot. President Lee said, "(President Trump) gave me the signing pen he had been using as a gift. I think it's because he remembered receiving the pen I used during our first summit meeting." <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 9박 10일 일정의 유럽 순방을 마치고 귀국 비행기에 오른 뒤 엑스(X·엑스)에 올린 글에서 이렇게 말했다. 이 대통령은 “어제 만찬 때 골프 얘기를 하며 우리 부부와 골프를 함께하겠다고 하여 아내가 손가락 걸고 약속을 받았는데, 오늘 오찬 후 헤어지면서 다시 골프를 꼭 함께 하자고 하셨다”며 “지나가는 말인 줄 알았는데 준비를 해야 할 것 같다. 각별히 관심 가져주신 트럼프 대통령께 감사드린다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 글과 함께 트럼프 대통령과 함께 만찬장에서 찍은 셀카 사진도 올렸다.)

item.title: [Exclusive] 'Ballot shortage' also occurred in last year's presidential election, the most recent local elections... "Not reported internally at the Election Commission" ([단독] ‘투표지 부족’ 지난해 대선·직전 지선 때도 있었다…“선관위 내부 보고 안 돼”)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC), which continues to face controversy due to ballot shortages in the June 3 local elections, has been found to have used additional ballots at some polling stations during the local elections four years ago and last year's presidential election. Although there were previous instances of ballot shortages, the NEC lowered the minimum threshold for printing ballots from the existing 60% to 50% ahead of this election. The NEC also demonstrated a lax grasp of the situation, reporting at the second meeting of the Democratic Party's "Citizen Suffrage Protection Task Force (TF)" on the 16th that "there were no previous ballot shortages." (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태로 논란이 계속되고 있는 중앙선거관리위원회가 4년 전 지방선거와 지난해 대통령 선거에서도 일부 투표소에서 추가 투표용지를 사용했던 것으로 확인됐다. 이전 선거에서도 투표용지 부족 사례가 있었지만 중앙선관위는 이번 선거를 앞두고 투표용지 인쇄매수 하한 기준을 기존 60%에서 50%로 하향했다. 중앙선관위는 지난 16일 더불어민주당 ‘국민참정권 수호 티에프(TF)’ 2차 회의에서 “이전에는 투표용지 부족이 없었다”고 보고하는 등 실태 파악도 허술했다.)

According to data obtained by Democratic Party lawmaker Lim Mi-ae from the NEC on the 18th, during the 8th local elections four years ago, 100 to 200 additional ballots were supplied to two polling stations. In one polling station in Goheung County, South Jeolla Province, one of the additionally distributed ballots was actually used. Additional ballots were also sent to one polling station during the 22nd general election held in 2024. Furthermore, in last year's 21st presidential election, additional ballots ranging from as few as 50 to as many as 500 were sent to 42 polling stations. Among these, 12 of the additionally distributed ballots were actually used at one polling station in Dalseong County, Daegu. It was found that in these three previous elections, there were no instances of voters waiting for ballots or voting being interrupted. The minimum threshold for printing ballots was 60% for the 8th local elections and 70% for the 22nd general election and 21st presidential election. (18일 임미애 민주당 의원이 중앙선관위로부터 받은 자료를 보면, 4년 전 제8회 지방선거 때도 투표소 총 2곳에 100∼200장의 추가 투표용지가 투입됐다. 이 중 전남 고흥군 한 투표소에선 추가배부 투표용지 1장이 실제로 사용됐다. 2024년 열린 22대 총선에서도 투표소 1곳에 추가 투표용지가 보내졌다. 또 지난해 21대 대선에선 투표소 42곳에 적게는 50장에서 많게는 500장의 투표용지가 추가로 보내졌다. 이 중 대구 달성군 한 투표소는 추가 배부된 투표용지 12장이 실제로 사용됐다. 다만 앞선 세 번의 선거에서는 선거인이 투표용지를 기다리며 대기하거나 투표가 중단된 사례는 없었던 것으로 파악됐다. 8회 지선의 투표용지 인쇄매수 하한 기준은 60%, 22대 총선·21대 대선은 70%였다.)

Despite previous ballot shortage cases, the NEC lowered the minimum threshold for printing ballots from 60% to 50% through the decision of the Secretary-General ahead of this election. It has also been revealed that the NEC did not prepare a response manual or crisis response system for ballot shortage situations during this local election. Lawmaker Lim pointed out, "As ballot shortages can occur at any time, the NEC needs to be vigilant and establish a precise response manual." (이전 선거에서도 투표용지 부족 사례가 있었음에도 중앙선관위가 이번 선거를 앞두고 사무총장 전결로 투표용지 인쇄매수 하한 기준을 기존 60%에서 50%로 낮췄다. 또 이번 지방선거에서 투표용지 부족 상황 발생 시 대처 매뉴얼과 위기 대응 체계도 준비하지 않은 것으로 드러났다. 임 의원은 “투표용지 부족은 언제든 일어날 수 있는 일인 만큼 선관위는 이에 대한 경각심을 갖고 대응 매뉴얼을 정확히 마련할 필요가 있다”고 지적했다.)

Meanwhile, the NEC, during its report on the ballot shortage situation at the second Democratic Party TF meeting on the 16th, stated that "no polling districts with ballot shortages in previous elections were confirmed or reported," indicating a poor grasp of the actual situation. Lawmaker Lim stated, "When the NEC reported to the Democratic Party TF, it stated that there were no previous ballot shortages, but that was not the case. The fact that, even if it didn't lead to voting interruptions, there were ballot shortages, and no internal reports were made at the NEC on how they were addressed, shows how complacent an organization the NEC is." (한편, 중앙선관위는 지난 16일 민주당 티에프 2차 회의에 투표용지 부족 사태 현황 보고를 하며 “이전 선거에서 투표용지가 부족했던 투표구는 확인·보고된 사실이 없었다”고 보고해 실태 파악도 허술했던 것으로 나타났다. 임 의원은 “선관위는 민주당 티에프 보고 때 이전에는 투표용지 부족 사태가 없었다고 답변했지만 실상은 그렇지 않았다”라며 “투표 중단 사태에 이르지 않았더라도 투표용지가 부족했고 어떻게 대응했는지 선관위 내부에서 전혀 보고가 이뤄지지 않은 것은 선관위가 얼마나 안일한 조직인지를 보여주는 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: "North Korean regime, our enemy" phrase from Yoon Suk Yeol era... Defense Ministry says "maintain," Unification Ministry says "must change" (윤석열 때 쓴 “북 정권, 우리의 적”…국방부 “유지” 통일부 “바꿔야”)
item.description:
On the 18th, the Ministry of National Defense issued a statement regarding media reports that the phrase "the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are our enemies," currently used in the '2026 Defense White Paper' slated for publication later this year, could be changed, asserting that "there is no change in the position that the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are our enemies." (올해 말 발간 예정인 ‘2026 국방백서’에서 기존의 ‘북한 정권과 북한군은 우리의 적’이란 표현이 바뀔 수 있다는 언론 보도에 대해 국방부가 “북한 정권과 북한군이 우리의 적이라는 입장에 변함이 없다”는 입장을 18일 냈다.)

Deputy Spokesperson Lee Kyung-ho stated this at the regular defense ministry briefing, saying, "The defense white paper for this year is currently in the process of drafting, and we are reviewing the direction for its composition." This indicates an intention to retain the phrase "the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are our enemies," which was explicitly stated in the '2022 Defense White Paper' published under the Yoon Suk Yeol administration. (이경호 부대변인은 이날 국방부 정례브리핑에서 “올해 국방백서는 현재 초안을 마련 중이고, 작성 방향을 검토하고 있다”며 이렇게 밝혔다. ‘북한 정권과 북한군은 우리의 적’이란 표현은 윤석열 정부 때 펴낸 ‘2022 국방백서 2022’에 명시됐는데, 이를 유지하겠다는 취지다.)

However, the Ministry of Unification expressed a differing opinion on this matter, stating during the inter-agency consultation process for the defense white paper that the phrase needs to be changed. A Unification Ministry official told reporters on the same day, "Peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula is the firm policy goal of the Lee Jae-myung administration. We cannot pursue peaceful coexistence with a principal enemy while designating North Korea as such," adding, "The concept of the 'principal enemy' should be discussed as an extension of the former Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in administrations, and the defense white paper also needs to be reviewed in this context." (그러나 통일부는 이에 대해 이견을 드러내며, 국방백서에 대한 부처 의견 수렴 과정에서 해당 표현의 변경이 필요하다는 입장을 밝혔다. 통일부 당국자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “한반도 평화공존은 이재명 정부의 확고한 정책 목표로, 북한을 주적으로 규정하는 상태에서 주적인 북한과 평화공존을 추구할 순 없다”며 “주적 개념은 과거 노무현·문재인 정부의 연장선상에서 논의돼야 하고, 국방백서도 이런 맥락에서 검토될 필요가 있다”고 말했다.)

Since the defense white paper contains the government's defense policy stance, there has been keen interest in how North Korea will be defined in the '2026 Defense White Paper,' the first to be published under the Lee Jae-myung administration. As the Lee Jae-myung administration proposed "peaceful coexistence on the Korean Peninsula" as its new North Korea policy, there were prospects that hostile expressions towards the North might be softened. However, with the continuing stalemate in inter-Korean relations, the Defense Ministry appears to be maintaining the previous administration's stance of designating the North Korean regime and military as the enemy. (국방백서는 정부 국방정책 기조를 담고 있기 때문에, 이재명 정부 들어 처음 발간되는 ‘2026 국방백서’에선 북한을 어떻게 규정할지 관심이 모였다. 이재명 정부가 ‘한반도 평화공존’을 새 대북정책으로 제시하면서, 북에 대한 적대적 표현이 완화될 수 있다는 전망도 나왔다. 그러나 남북 관계 경색이 계속되면서 국방부도 북한 정권과 북한군을 적으로 규정한 지난 정부 기조를 이어가고 있는 셈이다.)

The '2022 Defense White Paper,' published in 2023, stated for the first time in about six years that "the North Korean regime and the North Korean military, which have explicitly designated the Republic of Korea as an enemy and continue to pose military threats including nuclear weapons, are our enemies." The Yoon Suk Yeol administration intended to also publish a '2024 Defense White Paper' but failed to do so due to the fallout from the December 3 martial law declaration. (2023년 발간된 ‘2022 국방백서’는 6년여 만에 ‘대한민국을 명백한 적으로 규정하고 핵을 비롯한 군사 위협을 지속 가해오는 북한 정권과 북한군은 우리의 적’이라고 명시했다. 윤석열 정부는 ‘2024 국방백서’도 펴내려 했지만, 12·3비상계엄 여파로 발간하지 못했다.)

The debate over whether North Korea should be designated as an enemy or principal enemy has persisted for a long time. The expression 'principal enemy' was first used in the 1995 defense white paper under the Kim Young-sam administration, following North Korea's 'turn Seoul into a sea of fire' remarks in 1994. This term was used in defense white papers published until 2000. Then, starting with the 2004 defense white paper under the Roh Moo-hyun administration, it was replaced with phrases like 'direct military threat' and 'existing North Korean military threat.' Subsequently, in the '2008 Defense White Paper,' the first under the Lee Myung-bak administration, North Korea was described as a 'direct and serious threat.' The expression 'the North Korean regime and the North Korean military are our enemies' first appeared in the 2010 defense white paper following the Cheonan sinking incident. The Park Geun-hye administration also maintained this expression. (북한을 적 또는 주적으로 규정해야 하는지를 둘러싼 논쟁은 오랜 시간 이어졌다. ‘주적’ 표현은 1994년 북한의 ‘서울 불바다’ 발언을 계기로 김영삼 정부 때인 1995년 국방백서에 처음 사용됐다. 이후 2000년까지 발간된 국방백서에서 주적 표현이 쓰이다가, 노무현 정부 때인 2004년 국방백서부터 ‘직접적 군사위협’, ‘현존하는 북한의 군사적 위협’ 등으로 대체했다. 그 뒤 이명박 정부 첫 국방백서인 ‘2008 국방백서’엔 북은 ‘직접적이고 심각한 위협’으로 표현됐고, 천안함 사건이 발생한 2010년 국방백서에 ‘북한 정권과 북한군은 우리의 적’이란 표현이 처음 등장했다. 박근혜 정부도 이렇게 표현했다.)

In contrast, the defense white papers of 2018 and 2020 under the Moon Jae-in administration did not specifically designate North Korea as the enemy, instead using the phrase: "We consider any forces that threaten and infringe upon our sovereignty, territory, people, and property as our enemies." Citing the examples of the Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in administrations' defense white papers, which did not single out North Korea as the enemy, the Unification Ministry maintains that the Lee Jae-myung administration's defense white paper should also review related expressions in this context. (반면, 문재인 정부 때인 2018년과 2010년 국방백서에선 적을 북한으로 특정하지 않고, ‘주권, 국토, 국민, 재산을 위협하고 침해하는 세력을 우리의 적으로 간주한다’는 표현을 썼다. 통일부는 북한을 적으로 지목하지 않았던 노무현·문재인 정부 국방백서 사례를 들며, 이재명 정부 국방백서도 이런 맥락에서 관련 표현을 검토해야 한다는 입장이다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr Reporter Kwon Hyuk-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr 권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk hospitalized under 'resignation pressure'... "Overwork from fast, campaigns, and election commission crisis" (‘사퇴 압박’ 장동혁 입원…“단식·선거 이어 선관위 사태로 과로”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, visited the hospital emergency room on the 18th due to overwork and was admitted upon medical staff's recommendation. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 18일 과로로 인해 병원 응급실을 찾았다가 의료진의 권유로 입원했다.)

A party leadership official said, "Rep. Jang has accumulated fatigue from fasting, followed by local election campaign tours, and on-site responses to the National Election Commission crisis, leading to his hospitalization." (당 지도부 관계자는 “장 대표가 단식 이후 지방선거 지역 유세, 중앙선거관리위원회 사태 현장 대응 등으로 피로가 누적돼 입원했다”고 말했다.)

Rep. Jang had fasted for eight days in January, demanding 'dual special counsel investigations' into the 'Unification Church gate and allegations of bribery for Democratic Party nominations.' On the day of the June 3 local elections, when a shortage of ballot papers occurred, he visited the National Election Commission and the Seoul Election Commission overnight, and later shuttled between protest sites blocking vote counting stations at Olympic Park in Songpa-gu, Seoul. (장 대표는 지난 1월 ‘통일교 게이트·더불어민주당 공천 헌금 의혹'에 대한 ‘쌍특검’을 요구하며 8일 동안 단식했다. 6·3 지방선거 본투표 당일에는 투표 용지 부족 사태가 벌어지자 밤새 중앙선관위와 서울선관위 등을 찾았고, 이후 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 개표소 봉쇄 시위 현장을 오갔다.)

item.title: National Assembly Passes Resolution for Parliamentary Investigation into 'Ballot Shortage Incident'...45 Days Until August 1 (국회, ‘투표용지 부족 사태’ 국정조사 의결…8월1일까지 45일간)
item.description:
On the 18th, the National Assembly's plenary session passed a plan for a parliamentary investigation to uncover the truth behind the ballot shortage incident during the local elections held on the 3rd and to reform election management. (지난 3일 치러진 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 진상규명과 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사 계획서가 18일 국회 본회의를 통과했다.)

At the plenary session that day, the National Assembly, with 250 votes in favor and 1 against out of 251 attending members, approved the "Parliamentary Investigation Plan for Uncovering the Truth of the Infringement of Citizens' Suffrage Rights, Including the Ballot Shortage Incident in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections, and for Election Management Reform." Independent lawmaker Choi Hyuk-jin expressed his opposition. (국회는 이날 본회의를 열어 재석 의원 251명 중 찬성 250명, 반대 1명으로 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사계획서’를 의결했다. 최혁진 무소속 의원이 반대 의사를 밝혔다.)

The parliamentary investigation will be conducted for 45 days from today until August 1. The target institutions are the National Election Commission and all levels of election commissions. If an extension of activities is necessary, it can be approved through a vote in the plenary session. (국정조사는 이날부터 오는 8월1일까지 45일간 진행된다. 대상 기관은 중앙선거관리위원회 및 각급 선거관리위원회다. 활동을 연장할 필요가 있는 경우, 본회의 의결로 연장도 가능하다.)

The Special Committee on the Parliamentary Investigation consists of 18 members: 9 from the Democratic Party of Korea, 7 from the People Power Party, and 2 from non-negotiating groups (Lee Jun-seok of the Reform Party and Jeong Chun-saeng of the Fatherland Innovation Party). The chairperson of the special committee will be Yoon Sang-hyun of the People Power Party. (국정조사 특별위원회는 더불어민주당 9명, 국민의힘 7명, 비교섭단체 2명(이준석 개혁신당 의원, 정춘생 조국혁신당 의원) 등 총 18명으로 꾸려졌다. 특위 위원장은 윤상현 국민의힘 의원이 맡는다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Voting Records Reveal Chaos…"Borrowed 400 Ballots from Next Booth" "Unable to Contact Election Commission" (혼란상 담긴 투표록 보니…“옆 투표소서 400매 빌림” “선관위 연락 불가”)
item.description:
'Requested guidance at 15:51 after ballots were depleted, but received no response; was told a call would be made, but no contact followed.' 'All ballots exhausted at 16:35. Voting suspended after informing voters and observers.' (Voting record Songpa-gu Jamsil 2-dong, 6th polling station) (‘15:51 투표용지가 소진된 후 지침을 달라 요청했으나 답변받지 못했고 전화 다시 준다고 했으나 연락이 없음’, ‘16:35 투표용지 전량 소진. 선거인, 참관인께 안내 후 투표 중단함’(송파구 잠실2동 제6투표소 투표록))

Voting records detailing the situation at polling stations hit by ballot shortages during the June 3 local elections have been released. The records provide a minute-by-minute account of the confusion on the ground, expected to serve as key evidence in uncovering the truth behind the ballot shortage crisis. ( 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 투표소의 당시 상황이 기록된 ‘투표록’이 공개됐다. 투표소 현장에서 시간대별로 벌어진 혼란이 상세히 기록돼있어 투표용지 부족 사태 진상 규명에 핵심 근거가 될 전망이다.)

The voting records of 439 polling stations in Seoul's Songpa, Gangnam, Gwangjin, Dongjak, and Seocho districts—submitted by the National Election Commission to Rep. Joo Jin-woo of the People Power Party, a member of the Special Committee for Parliamentary Investigation into the Election Commission, and released on the 18th—capture the turmoil experienced by election officials and voters during the subsequent processes of extending voting hours, distributing waiting tickets, and transporting additional ballots. In Songpa, where the chaos was most severe, records from 52 polling stations were released, excluding those unavailable due to the blockade of Olympic Park. <<> At the Jamsil 2-dong, 6th polling station in Songpa-gu, where the ballot shortage was first reported, the 'special remarks' section of the voting record shows the first entry at 2:53 PM: 'Notified the dong that 238 ballots remain; requested additional supply.' Subsequently, three calls were made to the election commission between 3:10 and 3:40 PM, but no follow-up action was taken, and all ballots were exhausted by 4:35 PM. About one hour and 20 minutes later, at 5:59 PM, it was noted: 'Delivered 50 ballots without serial numbers.' After the ballots arrived, errors in manual entries on the supplementary ballots, such as missing stamps, occurred, and the handwriting shifted from neat script to illegible scrawl. <<> The situation was similar at the Jamsil 7-dong, 2nd polling station. The record states that at 3:30 PM, it was realized only 220 ballots remained; at 3:45 PM, an additional 200 were requested; and at 4:46 PM, voting was temporarily suspended, and waiting tickets were issued and explained to voters waiting in line. Starting at 5:39 PM, supplementary ballots were received, and serial numbers were entered manually. Details such as how many times and what content was broadcast via announcements at locations like Jamsil Woosung Apartment until 10 PM were also recorded. The number of people who received tickets but had not arrived by 8:35 PM was noted as 17, with visible corrections in the figure. <<> Elsewhere, records reveal various scenarios: 'Informed voters of ballot shortage and need to wait; some gave up and left due to lack of time' (Guui 3-dong, 3rd polling station), 'Borrowed 400 ballots from Garak 2-dong, 2nd polling station' (Garak 2-dong, 3rd polling station), and 'Informed of 100 ballots, but due to prolonged delay, resumed voting without verifying total count' (Jamsil 2-dong, 2nd polling station). These encompass instances of issuing ballots without serial numbers, borrowing ballots between stations, and voters abandoning voting or filing complaints. <<> Meanwhile, it has been revealed that the National Election Commission also used supplementary ballots at some polling stations during the local elections four years ago and last year's presidential election. According to data received by Rep. Im Mi-ae of the Democratic Party from the National Election Commission, during the 8th local elections four years ago, an additional 100 to 200 ballots were supplied to two polling stations. In the 22nd general election in 2024, supplementary ballots were sent to one polling station, and in last year's 21st presidential election, additional ballots—ranging from as few as 50 to as many as 500—were dispatched to 42 polling stations. However, it has been confirmed that there were no instances of voters waiting for ballots or voting being suspended in the three prior elections. <<> Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr Reporter Jeong Hye-min jhm@hani.co.kr ( ‘선관위 국정조사 특별위원회’ 소속 주진우 국민의힘 의원이 중앙선거관리위원회에서 제출받아 18일 공개한 서울 송파·강남·광진·동작·서초구 투표소 439곳의 투표록에는 투표용지 부족 상황 발생 뒤 벌어진 투표 시간 연장과 대기표 배부, 투표용지 추가 수송 등의 일련의 과정에서 투표관리인들과 유권자들이 겪었던 혼란이 고스란히 담겼다. 혼란이 극심했던 송파의 경우 올림픽공원 봉쇄 시위로 확보 불가한 투표록을 제외하고 52곳의 투표록이 공개됐다. )

item.title: 'National Assembly Audit of Election Commission' Passed in Plenary Session... Full-scale Investigation Begins Today for 45 Days (‘선관위 국조’ 국회 본회의 통과…오늘부터 45일간 본격 조사)
item.description:
A National Assembly audit to investigate the truth behind the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 local elections and to reform election management will be conducted for 45 days starting from the 18th until August 1. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 진상규명과 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국회 국정조사가 18일부터 8월1일까지 45일 동안 진행된다.)

On the 18th, the National Assembly held a plenary session and passed the 'Plan for a National Assembly Audit to Investigate the Truth Behind the Violation of Citizens' Voting Rights, Including the Ballot Paper Shortage in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections, and to Reform Election Management' with 250 votes in favor and 1 against (Independent Lawmaker Choi Hyeok-jin) out of 251 lawmakers present. (국회는 18일 본회의를 열어 재석 의원 251명 가운데 찬성 250명, 반대 1명(최혁진 무소속 의원)으로 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상규명 및 선거관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사계획서’를 의결했다.)

The targeted institutions are the National Election Commission and election commissions at all levels. The scope of the investigation includes: △ the circumstances leading to the ballot paper shortage; △ whether the process for establishing ballot paper print quantity calculation standards was flawed; △ the appropriateness of the election commission's on-site management and post-incident response on the day of the incident; △ measures regarding assemblies and protests at polling and counting stations, and police actions, as well as an overall review of election management. The investigation period can be extended through a plenary session resolution. The special committee consists of a total of 18 members, including Chairman Yoon Sang-hyun from the People Power Party, 9 from the Democratic Party of Korea, 7 from the People Power Party, and 2 from non-negotiating groups (Reform Party Lawmaker Lee Jun-seok and Motherland Innovation Party Lawmaker Jeong Chun-saeng). (대상 기관은 중앙선거관리위원회와 각급 선관위다. 조사 범위는 △투표용지 부족 사태 발생 경위 △투표용지 인쇄 수량 산정 기준 수립 과정의 부실 여부 △사태 당일 선관위의 현장 관리·사후 대응 적절성 여부 △투·개표소 집회 시위 및 경찰 조치 사항, 선거관리 전반 점검 등이다. 조사 기간은 본회의 의결을 통해 연장할 수 있다. 특위는 국민의힘 소속인 윤상현 위원장을 포함해 더불어민주당 9명, 국민의힘 7명, 비교섭단체 2명(이준석 개혁신당 의원, 정춘생 조국혁신당 의원) 등 총 18명으로 꾸려졌다.)

In the plenary session, the ruling and opposition parties also agreed to handle 30 non-contentious bills, including a partial amendment to the Act on the Award of War Medals for the Korean War, which expands the scope of bereaved families of Korean War veterans, and the Bicycle Act, which provides a basis for regulating fixie bicycles without brakes. (여야는 본회의에서 6·25 전쟁 공로자 유가족 범위를 확대하는 6·25전쟁 무공훈장 수여 등에 관한 법률 일부개정법률안과 브레이크가 없는 픽시 자전거 규제 근거를 담은 자전거법 등 비쟁점 법안 30개도 합의 처리했다.)

Reporter Jo Hee-yeon choh@hani.co.kr (조희연 기자 choh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: He said he "won't do the same old politics," but was his gamble a 'self-staged attack'? (“똑같은 정치 안 하겠다”더니, 승부수가 ‘피습 자작극’이었나)
item.description:
Amid the growing controversy surrounding the alleged 'self-staged attack' by Jeong Yi-han, the Reform Party candidate for Busan mayor in the June 3 local elections, attention is turning to his brief political career. Jeong, who ran for Busan mayor with the promise to "break away from the boring, same-old politics," could become the central figure in an unprecedented incident in Korean political history, depending on the outcome of the police investigation. <<> Born in Busan in 1988, Jeong's first steps in politics began with the People Power Party (PPP). After serving as the youth leader of a civic group, he worked in the offices of PPP lawmakers Baek Jong-heon and Park Soo-young, who represent Busan, from September 2022 to July 2024. Subsequently, he moved to work as an administrative officer in the Office of the Prime Minister under former Prime Minister Han Duck-soo until June of last year, before choosing to become the spokesperson for the Reform Party instead of staying with the PPP. <<> Regarding his choice of the Reform Party, Jeong appeared on a media outlet's YouTube channel in December last year and stated, "When Rep. Lee Jun-seok was ousted as party leader (of the PPP) and chose to walk his own difficult path, I thought it sent a clear message not just to me but to the younger generation. Seeing that, I truly made him a political role model in my life." <<> In that same interview, referring to former Prime Minister Han, who was then on trial for charges of engaging in important duties during the insurrection, Jeong said, "He is a person I truly respect on a personal level. Although he is going through a difficult time now, I hope it all ends and he can regain the peaceful life he originally sought to pursue." <<> Jeong, a political newcomer, gained national attention after media reports emerged that he was injured while trying to dodge a drink thrown by a man during an election campaign. On April 27, around 8:05 a.m., Jeong was handing out business cards to drivers waiting at a traffic light near Sejeong Tower in Geumjeong-gu, Busan. At the time, Jeong's camp claimed that when a driver threw a drink from inside the car, Jeong tried to evade it, fell, lost consciousness, and was taken to the hospital. Police arrested the driver, a man in his 30s, that afternoon at 2:20 p.m. Jeong later visited the man in custody, submitted a leniency petition, and returned to campaigning two days later on the 29th, wearing a neck brace. <<> His next move was a hunger strike. He protested against being excluded from broadcast debates organized by private media, while being allowed to participate in a broadcast debate hosted by the Busan Metropolitan Election Commission. On May 8, Jeong began a hunger strike, which he ended a week later due to deteriorating health. <<> During a broadcast debate, he caused controversy by pulling out a lie detector. At a debate hosted by the Busan Election Commission on May 26, Jeong suddenly produced a lie detector during the live broadcast. Stating that he had "personally imported it from the U.S. at my own expense," he asked Jeon Jae-soo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Busan mayor, "Although the investigation into the allegations against you (related to the Unification Church) has concluded, I would like to ask if you are willing to use a lie detector to dispel suspicions about yourself." However, Jeon refused, saying, "Please keep the necessary boundaries," so it was not actually used. The Busan Civic Coalition for Democratic Media criticized Jeong, saying he "trivialized and damaged the core democratic public sphere for his own 'political show.'" <<> After finishing third in the election, Jeong announced his retirement from politics. Just as he seemed to be forgotten, he became the center of controversy over the 'self-staged attack allegation.' The Weekly Chosun reported on the 17th that "the Busan Geumjeong Police Station is investigating Jeong on charges of obstructing official duties through deception, publishing false information, and violating the Public Official Election Act." The police suspect that Jeong's attack may have been staged. <<> It was also revealed that Jeong had already left the party using the party's online system. The Reform Party announced measures including launching an internal fact-finding team, pursuing no-tolerance legal action, and permanently banning him from rejoining the party. Reform Party leader Lee Jun-seok apologized, saying, "I feel an immense sense of responsibility," and added, "We will launch an internal fact-finding team and, based on the revealed facts, strictly hold Jeong accountable to the fullest extent under civil and criminal law." <<> Currently, no posts can be found on Jeong's Facebook page. As of the afternoon of the 18th, his Instagram account, still active, shows his last post from the 3rd. "I deeply thank you all for your support. Everyone has worked hard," he wrote, with a photo captioned "Busan Metropolitan City Mayor Candidate Jeong Yi-han, Young Busan Youth Mayor," showing him smiling and waving at the camera. <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-jun light@hani.co.kr (6·3 지방선거에 출마했던 정이한 개혁신당 부산시장 후보의 ‘피습 자작극’ 의혹이 일파만파 커지는 가운데 정 전 후보의 짧았던 정치 인생에 관심이 쏠린다. 부산시장에 출마하며 “지루하고 똑같던 정치에서 벗어나겠다”던 정 전 후보는 경찰 수사 결과에 따라 한국 정치사에서 유례를 찾아보기 힘든 초유의 사건을 일으킨 주인공이 될 수도 있다.)

item.title: Lee Jae-myung and Trump Discuss '453 Trillion Won Reconstruction Fund'... Government "Watching US-Iran Negotiations" (‘453조원 재건기금’ 논의한 이재명-트럼프…정부 “미-이란 협상 주시”)
item.description:
The ceasefire Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) signed by the United States and Iran includes a minimum of $300 billion (approximately 454 trillion won) in Iran reconstruction funds. With South Korean companies' potential participation also being mentioned, what role South Korea will play has become a significant variable. The presidential office stated that President Lee Jae-myung and U.S. President Donald Trump discussed this matter. (미국과 이란이 서명한 종전 양해각서(MOU)에 최소 3000억달러(약 454조원)의 이란 재건기금이 명시됐다. 한국 기업들의 참여도 거론되는 상황에서 한국이 어떤 역할을 하게 될지도 중요한 변수가 됐다. 이재명 대통령과 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 이에 대해서도 이야기를 나눴다고 청와대는 밝혔다.)

President Lee, who is visiting Europe, sat next to President Trump for 90 minutes during the official dinner of the Group of Seven (G7) summit in Évian-les-Bains, France on the 16th (local time) and discussed the 'Iran reconstruction fund'. A key presidential office official said, "President Lee expressed his will and capacity to substantially contribute to all international efforts, including those of the United States, to ensure free and safe navigation in the Strait of Hormuz in the future." (유럽을 방문한 이 대통령은 16일(현지시각) 프랑스 에비앙레뱅에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 공식 만찬에서 트럼프 대통령과 나란히 앉아 90분 동안 대화하며 ‘이란 재건 기금’에 대해 논의했다. 청와대 핵심 관계자는 “이 대통령은 향후 호르무즈해협 내 자유롭고 안전한 통항 보장을 위해 미국을 포함한 모든 국제사회 노력에 실질적으로 기여하겠다는 의지와 역량이 있다고 말했다”고 전했다.)

Despite these principled remarks, the nature and details of the Iran reconstruction fund are expected to be fleshed out during the 60-day consultation process between the U.S. and Iran, and the government is expected to monitor this closely before making a judgment. (이런 원칙적인 언급에도 불구하고 이란 재건 기금의 성격과 내용은 앞으로 60일 동안 미국과 이란의 협의 과정에서 구체화될 것으로 예상되고, 정부도 이를 주시하며 판단할 것으로 보인다.)

A foreign ministry official stated on the 18th that the reconstruction fund is "understood to be linked to the future final agreement on the Iranian nuclear issue," adding, "We will monitor related discussions and track trends in relevant countries." While reports have emerged that companies from South Korea, Japan, Singapore, and Malaysia have pledged investments, it is understood that no requests have yet been made to the South Korean government or companies, and other mentioned countries have also not received any requests. The framework of the reconstruction fund is expected to be determined only after specific discussions on U.S.-Iran nuclear negotiations, the future of the Strait of Hormuz, and sanctions relief. (외교부 당국자는 18일 재건기금은 “앞으로 진행될 이란 핵 문제에 관한 최종 합의와 연계된 사항으로 안다”면서 “관련 논의를 주시하면서 관련 국가 동향을 파악해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다. 한국을 비롯한 일본, 싱가포르, 말레이시아 등의 기업들이 출자를 약속했다는 보도가 나왔지만, 아직 한국 정부나 기업에 요청이 온 것은 없고 함께 거론된 다른 나라들도 요청을 받은 바가 없는 것으로 전해졌다. 미-이란 간의 핵 협의, 호르무즈해협의 미래, 제재 해제 등이 구체적으로 논의돼야 재건기금의 윤곽도 정해질 것으로 보인다.)

Among the 14 articles of the U.S.-Iran ceasefire MOU, Article 6 states that "the United States will establish a plan for Iran's reconstruction and economic development worth at least $300 billion with regional partners." Unlike traditional reconstruction or compensation programs that involve U.S. government funds, it is reportedly being discussed as a structure where private companies contribute funds to invest in Iran's energy, logistics, manufacturing, and transportation infrastructure. On the 17th (local time), President Trump told reporters after concluding the G7 summit schedule in Évian-les-Bains, "We are not paying. The U.S. doesn't have to give anything," adding, "But some people might want to invest." (14개항의 미-이란 종전 양해각서 가운데 제6항은 ‘미국이 역내 파트너들과 최소 3000억달러 규모의 이란 재건·경제 발전 계획을 수립”한다는 내용이다. 미국 정부 자금이 투입되는 전통적인 재건·배상 프로그램과 달리, 민간 기업들이 자금을 내 이란의 에너지·물류·제조·운송 인프라 등에 투자하는 구조로 논의되고 있다고 알려졌다. 트럼프 대통령은 17일(현지시각) 에비앙레뱅에서 주요 7개국 정상회의 일정을 마친 뒤 기자들과 만나 “우리는 돈을 내지 않는다. 미국은 아무것도 줄 필요가 없다”며 “다만 어떤 사람들이 투자하고 싶어 할 수는 있다”고 말했다.)

Experts also advise that participation and the method should be decided only after closely understanding the specific details agreed upon between the U.S. and Iran. (전문가들도 미국과 이란 사이에 구체적인 내용이 확정되는 것을 면밀히 파악한 뒤 참여 여부와 방식을 결정해야 한다고 조언한다.)

Former Ambassador to Iran Yoon Kang-hyun said, "It appears the U.S. is at the stage of conceptualizing with South Korean companies' participation in mind, but has not yet started specific discussions with the South Korean side," emphasizing the need to thoroughly understand how the fund will specifically operate before deciding on participation. Ambassador Yoon noted, "In 2016, the South Korean and Iranian governments agreed that the South Korean government would provide funds for South Korean companies to enter Iran for business, which Iran would later repay, but this fell through when the first Trump administration intensified sanctions on Iran," adding, "If it's a method where our companies directly engage in business, there might be room for participation, but if the U.S. just takes our money and operates it, it would be difficult to agree." He also advised that if South Korean companies participate, they must consider all technical issues, including fund recovery methods, and how U.S. sanctions relief on Iran will be implemented. (윤강현 전 주이란대사는 “미국이 한국 기업들의 참여 등을 염두에 두고 구상하는 단계이고 아직 한국 쪽과 구체적 논의를 시작한 단계는 아닌 것으로 보인다”면서 기금이 구체적으로 어떻게 운영될지를 잘 파악해 참여 여부를 결정해야 한다고 강조했다. 윤 대사는 “2016년에 한국 기업들이 이란에 들어가 사업을 하도록 한국 정부가 기금을 제공하고 나중에 이란이 갚는 방식으로 한국과 이란 정부가 합의했는데, 트럼프 1기 행정부가 이란 제재를 강화하면서 무산됐다”면서 “그런 방식으로 우리 기업들이 직접 사업을 하는 방식이라면 참여할 여지가 있지만 미국이 한국의 돈만 가져다 운영한다면 동의하기 어렵다”고 말했다. 한국 기업들이 참여한다면 자금 회수 방식을 비롯한 기술적인 문제들, 미국의 대이란 제재 완화가 어떤 방식으로 되는지를 모두 고려해야 한다고도 조언했다.)

Professor Yoo Dal-seung of the Department of Iranian and Persian Studies at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies also said, "While this reconstruction fund may involve U.S. companies' intent to capture the Iranian reconstruction market, we also need to consider participation to re-enter Iran." He further suggested, "To prevent our companies from just providing money, our government and companies should form a task force in advance, with the government playing various diplomatic roles. Discussions at the summit level, such as a presidential visit to Iran or an invitation for the Iranian president to visit South Korea, could also be good options." (유달승 한국외대 이란페르시아어과 교수도 “이번 재건 기금은 미국 기업들이 이란 재건 시장을 차지하려는 의도가 있지만, 우리도 이란에 다시 들어가기 위해 참여를 검토할 필요가 있다”고 말했다. 그러면서도 “우리 기업들이 돈만 내는 상황이 되지 않도록 우리 정부와 기업이 미리 태스크포스를 만들어서 정부가 여러 외교적 역할을 해야 하고, 대통령의 이란 방문이나 이란 대통령 방한 초청 등을 통해 정상 간 논의를 하는 것도 좋은 방안이 될 수 있다”고 제안했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: "Just Finish the Parliamentary Investigation and Step Down" – Calls for 'Modified Resignation' Toward Jang Dong-hyuk… Pro-Party Line Faction Objects (“국조만 하고 물러나라” 장동혁 향해 ‘수정 사퇴론’…당권파는 반발)
item.description:
On the 18th, within the People Power Party, a call for 'resignation after the parliamentary investigation into the National Election Commission' was raised against party leader Jang Dong-hyuk. This 'modified resignation' argument emerged, suggesting that Jang—who refuses to budge by citing 'resolving the NEC crisis' as his justification for staying—should step down after achieving that much. <<> Youth Supreme Council Member Woo Jae-jun said at the Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly that day, "I hope the leadership will conclude its term when the NEC situation is somewhat resolved, at least before autumn. If so, it could also alleviate the distrust that the leadership is exploiting the NEC crisis for political advantage." He had previously proposed the resignation of the entire leadership in a public statement on the 11th. It was reported that Leader Jang did not respond to Council Member Woo's proposal. <<> Lawmaker Kwak Kyu-taek, who serves as the head of the party's legal support team, also appeared on MBC Radio and said, "At the general meeting of lawmakers (the previous day), many said that rather than resigning immediately, the party leadership should decide its own course when the current phase, such as the parliamentary investigation into the flawed election situation, wraps up. I agree with that." A lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area told *The Hankyoreh*, "We need to provide a path for resignation after resolving the NEC crisis." Former lawmaker Yoo Seong-min appeared on Channel A's YouTube channel and said, "How long can Leader Jang hold out with the by-election issue? It's only a matter of time before he's replaced." <<> The pro-party line faction objected. Supreme Council Member Cho Gwang-han targeted Council Member Woo, saying, "There’s a person who keeps speaking in alien language whenever he grabs the mic," while Supreme Council Member Kim Min-soo, during a closed-door meeting, launched an offensive, saying, "Those who should take responsibility (for election results) should resign." In the Supreme Council meeting, Leader Jang proposed a meeting with Democratic Party leader Jung Cheong-rae, stating regarding the shortage of NEC ballot papers, "Now it's time for a special counsel. We must entrust a special counsel recommended by the People Power Party with uncovering the truth and punishing those responsible." This reiterated that resolving the NEC crisis is his mission. <<> Meanwhile, Leader Jang was hospitalized at a hospital in Seoul that day. A party official said, "Leader Jang visited the emergency room due to overwork, such as visiting the site of the protest blockade at the Olympic Park vote-counting center in Songpa-gu, Seoul, and was admitted on medical advice." <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (국민의힘에서 18일 장동혁 대표를 향해 ‘선거관리위원회 국정조사 뒤 사퇴론’이 제기됐다. ‘선관위 사태 해결’을 대표직 유지 명분으로 내세우며 꿈쩍 않는 장 대표에게 그것까지만 하고 물러나라는 ‘수정 사퇴론’이 나온 것이다.)

item.title: After Xi Jinping's Pyongyang Visit, 'Tacit Approval of North Korea Nukes' Theory Spreads… Seoul Conveys Concern That It Is 'Undesirable' (시진핑 방북 뒤 ‘북핵 묵인설’ 확산…정부 “바람직하지 않다” 우려 전달)
item.description:
Amid growing speculation that China has tacitly approved North Korea's nuclear weapons possession, following the omission of the phrase 'North Korean denuclearization' in the joint statement from the North Korea-China summit held in Pyongyang on the 8th, it has been reported that the South Korean government has conveyed its concern to China, stating that the 'spread of the tacit approval theory is undesirable.' (지난 8일 평양에서 열린 북중 정상회담에서 ‘북한 비핵화’ 표현이 사라지면서 중국이 북한 핵 보유를 묵인하기로 했다는 관측이 나오는 가운데, 한국 정부가 ‘북핵 묵인설이 확산하는 상황은 바람직하지 않다’는 우려를 중국에 전달한 것으로 알려졌다.)

According to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the 18th, Director-General for Northeast and Central Asian Affairs Nam Jin held a three-and-a-half-hour director-level consultation with visiting Chinese Foreign Ministry Director-General of the Department of Asian Affairs Liu Jinsong the previous afternoon, exchanging views on issues including the North Korean nuclear problem. Director-General Nam told reporters, "South Korea and China are communicating closely on matters of mutual interest, and during this consultation, which took place following President Xi Jinping's state visit to North Korea, there was strategic communication on the Korean Peninsula issue." He added, "I expressed the hope that the development of North Korea-China relations could contribute to peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula, and urged the Chinese side to continue to play a constructive role." (18일 외교부에 따르면 남진 외교부 동북·중앙아시아국장은 한국을 방문한 류진쑹 중국 외교부 아주국장과 전날 오후 3시간30분에 걸쳐 한중 국장급 협의를 하고 북핵 문제 등 현안에 대해 의견을 교환했다. 남진 국장은 이날 기자들에게 “한중 양국은 상호 관심사에 대해 긴밀히 소통하고 있으며 시진핑 주석의 북한 국빈 방문 이후 이뤄진 이번 협의에서도 한반도 문제에 대한 전략적 소통이 있었다”고 말했다. 그는 “저는 북중관계 발전이 한반도 평화 안정에 기여할 수 있기를 기대한다고 하고, 중국 측이 건설적 역할을 지속해 달라고 당부했다”고 밝혔다.)

Following the summit between Chinese President Xi Jinping and North Korean State Affairs Commission Chairman Kim Jong Un in Pyongyang on the 8th, the complete disappearance of references to 'denuclearization' from the statements issued by both countries has led to sustained observations that China has essentially shifted its policy to tacitly condone North Korea's nuclear arsenal. (앞서 지난 8일 평양에서 열린 시진핑 중국 국가주석과 김정은 북한 국무위원장과의 정상회담 뒤 양국 발표에서 ‘비핵화’ 관련 내용이 완전히 사라지면서 중국이 북한의 핵보유를 사실상 묵인하는 쪽으로 정책을 바꿨다는 관측이 이어졌다.)

It has been reported that the South Korean government conveyed the position that the continued spread of the theory of China's tacit approval of North Korean nukes is undesirable and not conducive to peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula. The Chinese side is said to have explained in response that "China's policy on the Korean Peninsula maintains continuity and stability." (한국 정부는 중국의 북핵 묵인설이 계속 확산하는 것이 바람직하지 않고, 한반도 평화·안정에 도움이 되지 않는다는 입장을 전한 것으로 알려졌다. 중국 측은 이에 대해 ‘중국의 한반도 정책은 연속성과 안정성을 유지하고 있다’고 설명한 것으로 전해졌다.)

China has long emphasized denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula, peace and stability on the Peninsula, and resolving issues through dialogue. The phrase 'continuity and stability' is interpreted as signaling that its existing stance of 'denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula' has not changed. A Foreign Ministry official stated, "The Chinese side has consistently expressed its position that it will play a constructive role for the stability of the situation on the Korean Peninsula." (중국은 오랫동안 한반도 비핵화, 한반도의 평화와 안정, 대화를 통한 문제 해결을 강조해왔는데 ‘연속성과 안정성’이란 표현으로 기존의 ‘한반도 비핵화’ 입장이 변하지 않았다는 뜻을 밝히는 것으로 해석된다. 외교부 당국자는 “중국 측도 한반도 정세 안정을 위해 건설적 역할을 해나가겠다는 입장을 일관되게 밝힌 바 있다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, it has been reported that the schedule for a visit to South Korea by Chinese Foreign Minister and State Councilor Wang Yi has not yet been finalized this time either. (이런 가운데 왕이 중국 외교부장 겸 국무위원의 방한 일정은 이번에도 정하지 못한 것으로 전해졌다.)

A Foreign Ministry official said, "The two sides are coordinating the schedule for Foreign Minister Wang Yi's visit to South Korea." Regarding whether South Korea's deletion of the 'China (Taiwan)' designation from its electronic arrival card influenced the delay of Minister Wang's visit, the Ministry official stated, "Minister Wang's visit and the Taiwan matter on the electronic entry form are unrelated," while also noting, "China considers the Taiwan issue a core element of its core interests, so there were related mentions during this meeting as well." (외교부 당국자는 “양측간에 왕이 부장의 방한 일정 관련 조율을 하고 있다”고 말했다. 한국이 전자입국신고서에서 ‘중국(대만)’ 표기를 삭제한 것이 왕이 부장의 방한이 미뤄지는 데 영향을 미쳤는지에 대해 외교부 당국자는 “왕이 부장 방한과 대만 전자입국신고서는 관련이 없다”면서도 “중국이 대만 문제를 핵심이익 중의 핵심으로 중시하고 있어서 이번 회의에서도 관련 언급이 있었다”고 말했다.)

In response to China raising the Taiwan issue, the South Korean side reaffirmed its position of respecting the 'One China' principle, as stated in the 1992 Joint Communiqué on the establishment of diplomatic relations. The Joint Communiqué includes the statement: "The Republic of Korea government recognizes the government of the People's Republic of China as the sole legitimate government of China, and respects the Chinese position that there is only one China and that Taiwan is a part of China." Director-General Nam said, "This position has remained unchanged across successive administrations." (중국의 대만 문제 거론에 대해 우리 측은 1992년 한중 수교 공동성명을 통해 밝힌 ‘하나의 중국’을 존중한다는 입장을 재확인했다. 한중 수교 공동성명에는 “대한민국 정부는 중화인민공화국 정부를 중국의 유일 합법 정부로 승인하며, 오직 하나의 중국만이 있고 대만은 중국의 일부분이라는 중국의 입장을 존중한다”는 입장이 담겨 있다. 남 국장은 “역대 정부에 걸쳐 이러한 입장에는 변함이 없다”고 말했다.)

During this consultation, the two sides also reviewed issues such as China's structures in the West Sea (Yellow Sea), the panda loan, and the preservation of Korean independence movement historic sites in China. It has been reported that China did not mention South Korea's discussions with the U.S. on building nuclear-powered submarines or uranium enrichment and reprocessing. (이번 협의에서는 양쪽은 중국의 서해 구조물 문제, 판다 대여와 중국 내 독립운동 사적지 보전 등도 점검했다. 한미가 협의를 시작한 한국의 핵잠 건조와 우라늄 농축·재처리 등에 대한 중국의 언급은 없었던 것으로 알려졌다.)

Director-General Nam Jin stated, "Both sides reaffirmed their commitment to consolidating the trend of full restoration of South Korea-China relations, which was established through mutual state visits by the leaders of the two countries in November last year and January this year, to continue the good momentum of high-level exchanges, and to implement the follow-up measures from the summit without a hitch in areas such as diplomacy, security, economy, culture, and people-to-people exchanges." (남진 국장은 “양측은 작년 11월과 올해 1월 양국 정상의 상호 국빈방문으로 형성된 한중관계 전면 복원 추세를 공고히 해나가고, 고위급 교류의 양호한 흐름을 이어가며 외교·안보·경제·문화·인적교류 등 분야에서 정상회담 후속조치를 차질 없이 이행해 나가자는 의지를 확인했다”고 밝혔다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yo-jong: G7's North Korea denuclearization statement is "the worst catastrophic choice... denounces it as an overreach" (김여정, G7 북한 비핵화 성명에 “최악의 재앙적 선택…월권행위 규탄”)
item.description:
Kim Yo-jong, director of the North Korean Workers' Party's General Affairs Department, pushed back against the Group of 7 (G7) leaders' joint statement urging North Korea's denuclearization, stating that "in any case, for anyone, touching the core interests of a nuclear weapons state will be the worst catastrophic choice." (김여정 북한 노동당 총무부장이 주요 7개국(G7) 정상 공동성명에서 북한 비핵화를 촉구한 것에 대해 “어떤 경우에도 그 누구에게도 핵보유국의 핵심 이익을 건드리는 것은 최악의 재앙적 선택이 될 것”이라고 반발했다.)

In a statement released through the Korean Central News Agency on the 18th, Director Kim said, "We express strong discontent and regret over the G7's act of overreach, which constitutes a direct infringement on our state constitution, and we categorically and unequivocally denounce and reject it," adding, "Nuclear weapons possession is our core interest that must be firmly upheld, and 'denuclearization' is an inviolable red line that can never be crossed." (김 부장은 18일 조선중앙통신을 통해 낸 담화에서 “우리 국가 헌법에 대한 직접적 침해로 되는 G7(주요7개국)의 월권행위에 강한 불만과 유감을 표시하며 이를 가장 명백한 어조로 단호히 규탄 배격한다”며 “핵 보유는 반드시 고수해야 할 우리의 핵심이익이며 ‘비핵화’는 절대로 넘어설 수 없는 불퇴의 선”이라고 말했다.)

On the 17th (local time), the leaders of the G7 issued a joint statement stating, "We express deep concern over North Korea's nuclear and ballistic missile programs, and reaffirm our commitment to realizing North Korea's complete denuclearization in accordance with UN Security Council resolutions." (지난 17일(현지시각) 주요 7개국 정상들은 공동성명에서 “우리는 북한의 핵 및 탄도미사일 프로그램에 깊은 우려를 표명하며, 유엔 안전보장이사회 결의에 따라 북한의 완전한 비핵화를 실현하겠다는 의지를 재확인한다”고 밝혔다.)

Pointing to this passage, Director Kim argued, "The G7, the main culprit in destroying world peace and security and the international nuclear non-proliferation regime (Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons, NPT), has neither the qualification to discuss nor the right to oppose the sovereign choices of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea." She called the West's denuclearization demands "anachronistic," saying, "Clearly, the claim for 'denuclearization' has completely lost its relevance to the times, and it will never be swayed by the volume of criticism from any group." (김 부장은 이 대목을 지적하며 “세계의 평화와 안전, 국제핵전파방지제도(핵비확산조약·NPT)를 파괴하는 주범인 G7은 조선민주주의인민공화국의 주권적 선택을 논할 자격도, 거스를 권리도 없다”고 주장했다. 그는 서방의 비핵화 요구가 “시대착오적”이라며 “명백히 ‘비핵화’ 주장은 시대성을 완전히 잃었으며 이는 결코 그 어떤 집단의 비난 목소리의 높낮이에 굴절되지 않는다”고 했다.)

She also stated, "The nuclear weapons we have acquired to defend ourselves, having been under constant and ongoing nuclear threats from hostile forces, will not cause concern for anyone except those who seek to harm us," and added, "The focus should be on examining the illogicality of the claim regarding our 'nuclear threat.'" Director Kim further emphasized that nuclear weapons are "a powerful means of defending sovereignty granted by the laws of the Republic and the cornerstone of peace guarantee," affirming that "as a self-defensive and responsive measure, our nuclear weapons will remain unchanged in both identity and permanence." (그는 또 “적수들로부터 항시적이고 지속적인 핵위협을 받아온 우리가 스스로를 지키기 위해 획득한 핵이야말로 우리를 해치려는 적수들 외에는 그 누구도 우려심을 가지지 않을 것”이라며 “여기에 초점을 두고 우리의 ‘핵위협’ 주장의 비논리성을 고찰해야 한다”고 말했다. 김 부장은 핵이 “공화국법이 부여한 주권 수호의 강위력한 수단이며 평화보장의 초석”이라며 “자위적, 대응적 수단으로서의 우리의 핵은 정체성도 존속성도 영구불변할 것”이라고 덧붙였다.)

North Korea continues to assert to the international community that it should be recognized as a nuclear weapons state, maintaining a firm stance against denuclearization demands. Last month, shortly after the security consultative body of the US, Japan, Australia, and India—the Quad—issued a statement emphasizing the commitment to North Korea's denuclearization, the North Korean Foreign Ministry issued a statement under the spokesperson's name declaring that North Korea's denuclearization "will never, ever happen." Regarding this latest G7 joint statement, Director Kim personally issued a critical statement. (북한은 국제사회를 향해 자신을 핵 보유국으로 인정해 줄 것을 주장하며, 비핵화 요구에 단호한 입장을 보이고 있다. 지난달 미국·일본·오스트레일리아·인도의 안보협의체 ‘쿼드’(Quad)가 북한 비핵화 의지를 강조하는 성명을 낸 직후엔 외무성 대변인 명의로 북한의 비핵화는 “절대로, 영원히 없을 것”이라는 입장을 냈다. 이번 주요 7개국 공동성명에 대해서는 김 부장이 직접 나서 비판 담화를 발표한 것이다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jeong Cheong-rae's 90-degree bow to President Lee... Cheongwadae requested him to come to the airport (정청래, 이 대통령 마중 ‘90도 인사’…청, 공항 나와달라 요청해)
item.description:
Jeong Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, attended President Lee Jae-myung's return event from his European tour on the 18th and gave a '90-degree' bow. With tensions rising between the party and the presidential office over Jeong's bid for a second term as party leader, a full-scale escalation was averted for now. However, an uncomfortable atmosphere is expected to persist ahead of the August 17 party convention. (이재명 대통령의 18일 유럽 순방 귀국 행사에 정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 참석해 ‘90도’ 인사를 했다. 정 대표의 당대표 연임 도전을 둘러싸고 당-청 갈등론이 고조되는 상황에서 일단 확전은 피한 셈이지만, 8·17 전당대회를 앞두고 불편한 기류는 이어질 것으로 보인다.)

President Lee arrived at Seoul Airport in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, at around 11:34 a.m. on this day, concluding his first 10-day, 8-night European tour, which included attending the Group of Seven (G7) summit in Évian-les-Bains, France. Accompanied by First Lady Kim Hye-kyung, President Lee stepped off Air Force One and exchanged brief handshakes with Prime Minister Kim Min-seok, Party Leader Jeong, Floor Leader Han Byung-do, Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, Senior Secretary for Political Affairs Hong Ik-pyo, and others, who were waiting. When President Lee stood before him, Party Leader Jeong bowed nearly 90 degrees, and President Lee said to him, "Well done." President Lee did not converse with Prime Minister Kim. <<> The presidential office reportedly requested Party Leader Jeong's attendance the day before. It is said that the presidential office deliberated for nearly a week on whether to invite Jeong. The presidential office appears to have judged that, amid the simultaneous decline in approval ratings for both President Lee and the Democratic Party, a shaky party-presidential office relationship and escalating conflicts reminiscent of a civil war would not be beneficial. On the 9th, during the send-off event for President Lee's European tour, Party Leader Jeong was absent while Prime Minister Kim attended, sparking speculation that the presidential office had sent a veto signal to Jeong. <<> Despite the 'airport welcome,' the embers of conflict have not been extinguished, according to views both inside and outside the party. <<> Later, at a general meeting of Democratic Party lawmakers held at the National Assembly, Party Leader Jeong greeted members and said, "Is there any life that isn't difficult? Isn't life about going through it, shaking and getting wet?" Quoting poet Do Jong-hwan's 'Flowers Bloom While Swaying,' this is presumed to express his discomfort at being pressured from within and outside the party not to run for the party convention. <<> Political interpretations are also arising from President Lee's unprecedented decision to personally brief the results of his tour at Cheongwadae on the 19th. Typically, after a tour, the president has invited the leaders of the ruling and opposition parties to Cheongwadae to share the tour's achievements. There is chatter among party and presidential office circles that this may reflect the awkwardness of sitting face-to-face with Party Leader Jeong. Within Cheongwadae, there remains lingering resentment over Party Leader Jeong's remark during President Lee's tour that "No government can defeat the people; the people are eternal, and the government is short-lived." At the time, Cheongwadae reacted with indignation, with some saying, "Isn't this effectively advocating for splitting the party?" <<> By Koh Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr and Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (이 대통령은 프랑스 에비앙에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 참석을 계기로 한 8박10일 동안의 첫 유럽 순방을 마친 뒤, 이날 오전 11시34분께 경기 성남 서울공항에 도착했다. 이 대통령은 김혜경 여사와 함께 공군 1호기에서 내려 기다리고 있던 김민석 국무총리와 정 대표, 한병도 원내대표, 강훈식 대통령비서실장, 홍익표 정무수석 등과 차례로 짧은 악수를 했다. 정 대표는 이 대통령이 앞에 서자 90도 가까이 허리를 숙여 인사했고, 이 대통령은 정 대표에게 “수고했습니다”라고 말했다. 이 대통령은 김 총리와는 대화를 나누지 않았다.)

item.title: City and Provincial Election Commission Chairs, Serving as Non-standing Concurrent Positions, Only Commute ‘Once a Month’ Even in Election Years (‘비상임 겸직’ 시·도 선관위원장, 선거 있는 해에도 ‘월 1회’만 출근)
item.description:
City and provincial election commission chairs, who oversee election affairs for 17 metropolitan governments nationwide, were found to commute to their offices an average of once a month. Despite the unique nature of their roles as ‘concurrent non-standing chairs,’ their average commuting days remained similar even in years when major elections such as presidential and general elections were held. (전국 17개 광역자치단체의 선거 사무를 총괄하는 시·도 선거관리위원장들이 평균 한 달에 한 번 선관위에 출근한 것으로 나타났다. ‘겸직 비상임 위원장’이라는 특수성은 있지만 대선·총선 등 선거가 열리는 해에도 평균 출근 일수는 비슷했다.)

According to data on ‘Attendance Days for Election Commission Chairs at All Levels over the Past Five Years’ released on the 18th by Rep. Chae Hyun-il of the Democratic Party of Korea, the annual average number of commuting days for chairs of the 17 city and provincial election commissions from 2022 to last year was 14.2 days. This translates to 1.2 days per month. (18일 채현일 더불어민주당 의원이 공개한 ‘최근 5년간 각급 선관위원장 출무일수’ 자료를 보면, 2022년부터 지난해까지 전국 17개 시·도선관위원장의 연평균 출근일은 14.2일이다. 한 달에 1.2일을 출근한 셈이다.)

The situation was no different in years when nationwide elections were held. In 2022, when both the presidential and local elections took place, in 2024, when the general election was held, and last year, when the presidential election occurred, the annual average commuting days for city and provincial election commission chairs were 14.9 days, 15 days, and 15.6 days, respectively. This year, as of the 9th, over approximately five months, the average commuting days stood at 11.4 days. (전국 단위 선거가 열린 해에도 다르지 않았다. 대선과 지방선거가 함께 치러진 2022년, 총선이 열린 2024년, 대선이 열린 지난해 전국 시·도선관위원장의 연평균 출근일은 각각 14.9일, 15일, 15.6일이었다. 올해는 지난 9일까지 약 5개월간 평균 출근일은 11.4일이었다.)

For the National Election Commission (NEC) chair, the annual average commuting days between 2022 and June 9, 2026, was 49.8 days, amounting to an average of 4.2 days per month. In 2022, when both the presidential and local elections were held, commuting days were only 33, while last year, the chair commuted 69 days. (중앙선관위원장의 경우 2022~2026년 6월9일 사이 연평균 출근일은 49.8일로, 한 달 평균 출근일수가 4.2일이었다. 대선과 지방선거가 함께 열린 2022년 출근일은 33일에 그쳤고, 지난해에는 69일 출근했다.)

The low number of commuting days for election commission chairs at all levels is attributed to the ‘non-standing concurrent position structure.’ The NEC chair is concurrently held by a Supreme Court justice, while city and provincial election commission chairs are concurrently held by the heads of respective district courts. Recently, political circles have discussed reforming the election commission by changing all-level chairs from non-standing concurrent roles to full-time, responsible positions. (각급 선관위원장들의 출근일수가 적은 이유로 선관위원장의 ‘비상임 겸직 구조’가 꼽힌다. 중앙선관위원장은 대법관이, 시·도선관위원장은 관할 지방법원장이 겸직하고 있다. 이에 최근 정치권에서는 각급 선관위원장을 비상임 겸직이 아닌 상임·책임직으로 바꾸는 선관위 개혁 방안이 거론되고 있다.)

On this day, the National Assembly held a plenary session and approved, through bipartisan agreement, the ‘Plan for a Parliamentary Investigation to Clarify the Truth Behind the Infringement of Citizens’ Political Rights, Including the Shortage of Ballot Papers in the 9th Nationwide Simultaneous Local Elections, and to Reform Election Management.’ The special committee for the parliamentary investigation plans to clarify responsibilities, including dereliction of duty by the election commission, in the occurrence of the ‘June 3 Local Election Ballot Shortage Incident’ and the subsequent recovery process, and to devise comprehensive reforms and preventive measures for the overall election management system. (국회는 이날 본회의를 열어 ‘제9회 전국동시지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상 규명 및 선거 관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사계획서'를 여야 합의로 승인했다. 국회 국정조사 특별위원회는 ‘6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태’ 발생과 사후 수습 과정에서 나타난 선관위의 직무 유기 등 책임을 규명하고, 선거 관리 제도 전반에 대한 대대적인 개혁과 재발 방지 대책을 마련할 계획이다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee to Brief on Diplomatic Tour Outcomes on the 19th… Eyes on Progress in ‘North Korea-U.S. Talks’ (이 대통령, 19일 순방 성과 브리핑…‘북미 대화’ 진전 여부 촉각)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung has decided to personally brief on the results of his European tour on the 19th. Given that he held discussions on topics such as peace on the Korean Peninsula with U.S. President Donald Trump during the Group of Seven (G7) summit, attention is focused on whether specific details regarding progress in North Korea-U.S. relations will emerge. (이재명 대통령이 19일 유럽 순방 결과를 직접 브리핑하기로 했다. 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 기간 중 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령과 한반도 평화 등을 주제로 대화를 나눈 만큼, 북-미 관계 진전과 관련한 구체적인 내용이 나올지 주목된다.)

Senior Presidential Spokesperson Kang Yoo-jung stated on the 18th, “President Lee plans to personally brief on the outcomes and achievements of his official visit to Belgium, the European Union (EU) summit, his state visit to Italy, and the G7 summit at the Chunwadae Spring and Autumn Pavilion on the 19th at 2 p.m.” President Lee returned home that day after completing his first European tour of eight nights and ten days. This marks the first time President Lee is explaining the results of his diplomatic tour. ( 강유정 청와대 수석대변인은 18일 “이 대통령이 19일 오후 2시 벨기에 공식 방문, 유럽연합(EU) 정상회담, 이탈리아 국빈방문 및 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 결과와 성과에 대해 청와대 춘추관에서 직접 브리핑을 할 예정”이라고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 이날 8박10일간의 첫 유럽 순방을 마치고 귀국했다. 이 대통령이 순방 결과를 설명하는 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

The briefing is expected to specifically mention the content of the conversation between President Lee and President Trump regarding peace on the Korean Peninsula. On the 16th (local time), President Lee sat next to President Trump at the official dinner of the G7 summit held in Évian-les-Bains, France, and engaged in a discussion lasting about one hour and 30 minutes. On the 17th, President Lee wrote on X (formerly Twitter), “Last night, I had dinner with President Trump and shared a deep conversation for 90 minutes about peace on the Korean Peninsula and South Korea-U.S. relations, and we made much progress.” He also conveyed that he received two golf invitations from President Trump and was gifted a signing pen, adding, “The South Korea-U.S. alliance is solid and eternal.” ( 브리핑에서는 이 대통령과 트럼프 대통령이 한반도 평화와 관련해 나눈 대화 내용이 구체적으로 언급될 것으로 예상된다. 이 대통령은 지난 16일(현지시각) 프랑스 에비앙레뱅에서 열린 주요 7개국 정상회의 공식 만찬에서 트럼프 대통령 바로 옆자리에 앉아 1시간30분가량 대화를 나눴다. 이 대통령은 17일에는 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 “어제저녁 트럼프 대통령님과 만찬을 함께하며 90분간 한반도 평화와 한-미 관계를 놓고 속 깊은 이야기를 나누고 많은 진전이 있었다”고 썼다. 또 트럼프 대통령으로부터 골프 약속 제안을 두차례 받고, 서명용 펜도 선물받았다는 사실을 전하며 “한-미 관계는 단단하고 영원하다”고 했다.)

Experts say that conditions for resuming North Korea-U.S. summit talks are not yet ripe. Hong Min, a senior research fellow at the Korea Institute for National Unification, stated, “Even if North Korea does not hold talks with President Trump, it is experiencing a favorable moment through its relations with China and Russia, so it will not easily respond to North Korea-U.S. negotiations. However, if the U.S. consistently communicates at a high level that it will no longer pursue ‘denuclearization’ as a goal, there is a possibility that North Korea might come forward to gauge its intentions.” ( 전문가들은 북-미 정상회담 재개 조건이 성숙된 상황은 아니라고 말했다. 홍민 통일연구원 선임연구위원은 “북한은 트럼프 대통령과 회담을 하지 않더라도 중국과 러시아와의 관계를 통해 호기를 맞고 있기 때문에 쉽게 북-미 협상에 응하지 않을 것”이라면서도 “다만 미국이 고위급 차원에서 ‘비핵화’를 더 이상 목표로 하지 않겠다는 일관된 메시지를 내놓는다면, 북한이 진의를 파악하기 위해 나올 가능성은 있다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, Kim Yo-jong, director of the North Korean Workers' Party's General Department, issued a statement through the Korean Central News Agency on this day, criticizing the G7 joint statement that included a reaffirmation of “the realization of complete denuclearization of North Korea.” She said, “Touching on the core interests of a nuclear-possessing state will be the worst catastrophic choice,” and emphasized, “Possessing nuclear weapons is our core interest that must be firmly upheld.” ( 이런 가운데 김여정 북한 노동당 총무부장은 이날 조선중앙통신을 통해 내놓은 담화에서 ‘북한의 완전한 비핵화 실현 재확인’을 담은 주요 7개국 공동성명에 대해 “핵보유국의 핵심 이익을 건드리는 것은 최악의 재앙적 선택이 될 것”이라며 “핵보유는 반드시 고수해야 할 우리의 핵심 이익”이라고 밝혔다.)

Separately, President Lee plans to invite diplomatic envoys from 118 countries and representatives from 30 international organizations to a dinner at the Chunwadae on the 23rd. Senior Spokesperson Kang explained, “We plan to present key directions for the full-scale implementation of ‘practical diplomacy’ in the second year of the administration and request support and cooperation.” ( 한편 이 대통령은 오는 23일 청와대에 118개국 외교사절과 30개 국제기구 대표들을 초청해 만찬을 열기로 했다. 강 수석대변인은 “국정 2년차 ‘실용외교’ 본격화를 위한 핵심 방향을 제시하고 지지와 협력을 당부할 계획”이라고 설명했다.)

item.title: Divided People Power Party, Seething Democratic Party… Both Sides in 'Family Feud' (갈라진 국힘, 들끓는 민주…여야 모두 ‘집안 싸움’)
item.description:
<<>> ()

The People Power Party is in the throes of severe internal strife due to the aftermath of its crushing defeat in the June 3 local elections. With responsibility for the landslide loss—where it secured only 4 out of 16 metropolitan mayor and governor seats—voices demanding the resignation of leader Jang Dong-hyuk are clashing head-on with the pro-leadership faction trying to block them, splitting the party in two. ()

Pressure for resignation is erupting from all sides. At the Supreme Council meeting on the 18th, Youth Supreme Council member Woo Jae-joon called for Jang to step down before autumn, and lawmakers from the Gyeonggi region held a press conference demanding his resignation ahead of a general meeting of lawmakers. At the previous day's general meeting, younger lawmakers demanding his resignation and the pro-leadership faction defending Chairman Jang clashed fiercely, exchanging heated words laced with emotion. Chairman Jang has even been hospitalized due to overwork and aftereffects of a hunger strike, but shows no sign of intending to resign. ( 국민의힘이 6·3 지방선거 참패의 후폭풍으로 극심한 내홍을 겪고 있습니다. 광역단체장 16곳 중 4곳만 건진 참패의 책임을 놓고 장동혁 대표의 사퇴를 요구하는 목소리와 이를 막아서는 당권파가 정면으로 맞서면서, 당이 두 쪽으로 갈라진 모습입니다.)

The ruling party's situation is also far from calm. President Lee Jae-myung returned home on this day after an 8-night, 10-day European tour. Although rumors of a party-presidential office conflict arose after the Democratic Party leadership skipped the departure ceremony, the presidential office summoned Representative Jung Chung-rae to the welcome-back event. Representative Jung greeted with a deep, nearly 90-degree bow, and President Lee responded with "Good work." The party-presidential office conflict appears to have been patched up for now, but internally, the Democratic Party is seething over Representative Jung's bid for a second term. ( 사퇴 압박은 곳곳에서 터져 나오고 있습니다. 18일 최고위원회의에서는 우재준 청년최고위원이 가을 전 임기 종료를 요구했고, 경기 지역구 의원들은 의원총회에 앞서 사퇴 촉구 기자회견을 열었습니다. 전날 의원총회에서도 사퇴를 요구하는 소장파와 장 대표를 엄호하는 당권파가 격하게 충돌하며 감정 섞인 언쟁이 오갔습니다. 장 대표는 과로와 단식 후유증으로 입원까 지 했지만, 사퇴 의사를 보이지 않고 있습니다.)

Amidst fierce pressure to resign and deepening conflict, how much longer can Chairman Jang Dong-hyuk's shaky leadership hold out? Can the ruling party, seemingly mended by the polite exchange between the president and the party leader, avoid division while carrying the ticking time bomb of Representative Jung Chung-rae's bid for re-election? Will the truth behind the shortage of local election ballots be properly uncovered in the parliamentary investigation of the National Election Commission—the first ever launched under the constitution? Find out on 'Gongdeok Pub.' Check it out in the video! ( 여권의 사정도 평온하지 않습니다. 이재명 대통령이 8박 10일 유럽 순방을 마치고 이날 귀국했습니다. 출국 행사에 더불어민주당 지도부가 빠지며 당청 갈등설이 일었지만, 청와대가 귀국 환영 행사에 정청래 대표를 불렀습니다. 정 대표는 약 90도로 깍듯이 인사했고, 이 대통령은 “수고했습니다”라고 받았습니다. 당청 갈등은 일단 봉합된 모양새지만, 정작 민주당 내부는 정 대표의 연임 도전을 둘러싸고 들끓고 있습니다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk: "I Cannot Agree with the Assessment That I Should Have Yielded in Pyeongtaek-eul"... Rebuttal to Criticism from Park Ji-won (조국 “‘평택을 양보’ 했어야 한다는 평가 동의 못해”…박지원 비판에 반박)
item.description:
Cho Kuk, former leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, said on the 19th regarding the June 3 local elections and National Assembly by-elections, "I cannot agree with the assessment that I should have yielded and withdrawn in Pyeongtaek-eul, Gyeonggi Province." This is a rebuttal to comments made the previous day by Park Ji-won, a five-term lawmaker of the Democratic Party of Korea, who said, "Cho Kuk himself broke the solidarity of progressive forces." (조국 조국혁신당 전 대표가 6·3 지방선거 및 국회의원 재보선과 관련해 “조국이 (경기) 평택을에서 양보하고 사퇴했어야 했다는 평가에 동의할 수 없다”고 19일 말했다. 전날 박지원 더불어민주당 의원(5선)이 “진보세력의 연대를 깬 것은 조국 자신”이라고 말한 데 대한 반박이다.)

In a post on his Facebook page on the 19th, former leader Cho stated, "In the June 3 elections, the Innovation Party unified or withdrew candidates in 12 areas, including Sejong, Ulsan, Changwon, and Gimhae, to support Democratic Party candidates." He added, "The Democratic Party had no intention of yielding anywhere, so is it not a problem for the Democratic Party to field a candidate in Pyeongtaek-eul, but if the Innovation Party does so, it breaks solidarity?" He then addressed Representative Park, saying, "According to this assessment, the Cho Kuk Innovation Party should not field any candidates in the 2028 general elections, or if it does, it should withdraw midway. However, such a thing will not happen." (조 전 대표는 19일 자신의 페이스북에 글을 올려 “혁신당은 6·3 선거에서 세종, 울산, 창원, 김해 등 12군데에서 단일화 또는 후보 사퇴를 통해 민주당 후보를 밀어주었다”며 “민주당은 어느 곳도 양보할 생각이 없었는데, 민주당이 평택을에 후보를 내도 문제가 없고 혁신당이 후보를 내면 연대를 깨는 것이냐”고 했다. 그러면서 박 의원에게 “이런 평가대로라면 28년 총선에서 조국혁신당은 후보를 내지 말거나 후보를 내더라도 중도 사퇴해야 한다”며 “그러나 그런 일은 없을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Former leader Cho said, "Throughout the elections, I consistently maintained the stance that if there was a possibility of the People Power Party winning, unification should occur. Candidate Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party completely rejected unification." He directed his remarks at Representative Park, asking, "As a senior figure, shouldn't you have emphasized the need to follow the process of unification?" (조 전 대표는 “선거에서 나는 줄곧 국힘이 승리할 가능성이 있다면 단일화를 해야 한다는 입장을 견지했고, (민주당) 김용남 후보는 단일화를 완전히 거부했다”며 박 의원을 향해 “원로로서 단일화 절차를 밟아야 한다고 강조하셨어야 했던 것 아닌가”라고 했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)
