item.title: People Power Party moves to abolish early voting system…Han Dong-hoon also listed as co-sponsor (사전투표제 폐지 나선 국힘…한동훈도 공동발의자로)
item.description:
The People Power Party has proposed a revision to the Public Official Election Act that would abolish early voting and extend the main voting period to two days. Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon, who was expelled from the People Power Party, has been listed as a co-sponsor of this bill. <<> PPP lawmaker Park Dae-chul announced on the 19th that he had proposed such a revision to the Public Official Election Act. This is the first time a bill to abolish the early voting system has been proposed since the shortage of ballot papers in the June 3 local elections. <<> According to the proposed revision, the early voting system would be abolished, and the current one-day main voting period would be extended to two days. It also includes the reintroduction of an "absentee voting system," allowing voters who cannot participate in the main voting to vote in advance for two days starting four days before the election, provided they have reported in advance. <<> Park explained the reason for proposing the bill, stating, "The early voting system was originally introduced to increase voter accessibility, but its side effects have surpassed its legislative benefits, and the current system has skewed too heavily toward 'convenience,' repeatedly undermining the essence of elections: fairness and credibility." <<> A total of 25 lawmakers, including Kim Sang-hoon, Yoon Young-seok, Kim Sung-won, Kim Jung-jae, Song Eon-seok, Shin Dong-wook, Lee Man-hee, and Kwon Young-jin, joined as co-sponsors of the bill. One lawmaker who participated in this proposal said on Facebook the previous day, "Abolishing early voting and extending the main voting period has long been my view." <<> Reporter Kim Hae-jung sea@hani.co.kr (국민의힘에서 사전투표를 폐지하고 본 투표일을 이틀로 늘리는 내용의 공직선거법 개정안이 발의됐다. 이 법안에는 국민의힘에서 제명된 한동훈 무소속 의원이 공동 발의자로 이름을 올렸다.)

item.title: Critics Say "Is This Han Dong-hoon?" Over Jung Cheong-rae’s "90-Degree Bow" – "The President Dislikes It" (‘90도’ 정청래에 “한동훈이냐” “이 대통령 싫어해”)
item.description:
When President Lee Jae-myung returned from his European tour, Democratic Party Representative Jung Cheong-rae gave a "90-degree bow," sparking reactions that it recalled the "folder bow" that independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon had offered to former President Yoon Suk-yeol. Within the pro-Lee faction of the Democratic Party, sharp criticism emerged, calling it "etiquette the President dislikes" and labeling it "a political technique with political intent." <<> Former Deputy Director of the People Power Party’s Yeouido Research Institute, Jang Ye-chan, said on Facebook on the 18th that Jung’s bow reminded him of Han’s "90-degree bow," claiming, "Now Jung Cheong-rae is the Han Dong-hoon of the Democratic Party." He added, "The People Power Party members and supporters who trusted Han Dong-hoon’s 90-degree bow ultimately regretted it deeply. I have no affection for the Democratic Party or the Lee Jae-myung government, but I want to offer advice not to repeat the same mistakes we made." <<> On January 23, 2024, at the scene of a fire at the Seocheon Specialized Market in Seocheon County, South Chungcheong Province, Han, then chair of the People Power Party’s Emergency Response Committee, bowed deeply to former President Yoon in a "folder bow." <<> Prior to this, Han had stated regarding First Lady Kim Keon-hee’s acceptance of a luxury handbag that "it’s a matter to consider from the public’s perspective." The presidential office then demanded Han’s resignation from his emergency committee chairmanship less than a month into his tenure. Analysts suggested this was because he "touched the taboo of First Lady Kim Keon-hee." In that context, Han’s "90-degree bow" occurred, and afterward, former President Yoon reportedly returned to Seoul with Han on the presidential train, temporarily mending the rift between them. <<> Attorney Seo Jeong-wook, reportedly close to former President Yoon and his wife, offered a similar interpretation. On CBS Radio’s "Park Jae-hong’s One-Round Show" on the 18th, Seo stated, "When President Yoon visited the fire site, Representative Han also bowed nearly 90 degrees. But did their relationship improve after that? In the end, it ended in collapse. The relationship between Representative Jung and President Lee is the same. It will ultimately end in ruin." <<> From the pro-Lee faction, the criticism labeled it "political technique." <<> Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Geon-tae wrote on Facebook on the 18th, "Representative Jung Cheong-rae’s 90-degree bow is truly wrong behavior. As far as I know, President Lee Jae-myung does not want this kind of formality. In fact, he openly dislikes it. Representative Jung surely knows that." He added, "In that sense, the 90-degree bow is a political technique driven by political intent and a political act." <<> On the 18th, President Lee arrived at Seoul Air Base in Seongnam, Gyeonggi Province, after completing his first European tour of 10 days and 8 nights. As President Lee stepped off Air Force One, he exchanged brief handshakes with Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and Representative Jung, who were waiting. When President Lee stood before him, Representative Jung bowed nearly 90 degrees, and President Lee responded, "Good work." <<> Reporter Jeon Gwang-joon light@hani.co.kr (이재명 대통령이 유럽 순방 뒤 귀국할 때 정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 ‘90도 인사’를 한 것을 두고 윤석열 전 대통령에게 ‘폴더 인사’를 했던 한동훈 무소속 의원이 떠오른다는 반응이 나왔다. 민주당 친명계에서는 “이 대통령이 싫어하는 의전”이라며 “정치적 의도가 담긴 정치 기술”이라는 날 선 비판도 나왔다.)

item.title: Joo Jin-woo: "82% of NEC Contracts Over 5 Years Were Private Contracts… Requests Anti-Corruption Commission Investigation into Conflicts of Interest" (주진우 “5년간 선관위 계약 82% 수의계약…이해충돌 권익위 조사 의뢰”)
item.description:
The National Election Commission (NEC), embroiled in controversy over a poor election management due to a shortage of ballot papers, has been found to have executed more than 8 out of every 10 contracts as private contracts over the past five years.
